cover_headline: Who Is Rohit Prasad? The Ranchi Engineer Who Built Alexa — and Now Runs Boston Dynamics

end.headline: Who Is Rohit Prasad? The Ranchi Engineer Who Built Alexa — and Now Runs Boston Dynamics
end.line: The speech scientist who put a voice assistant in hundreds of millions of homes left Amazon at the end of 2025 — and on October 7 became only the third CEO in Boston Dynamics' 34 years.

facts: Rohit Prasad became CEO of Boston Dynamics on October 7, 2026 — only the third chief executive in the company's 34-year history
At Amazon he led Alexa, a service used in hundreds of millions of households; by 2023 customers had bought well over half a billion Alexa-enabled devices
Hyundai plans to deploy Atlas humanoids at its Georgia plant from 2028 and build capacity to produce 30,000 robots a year

quote.speaker: Rohit Prasad
quote.text: Boston Dynamics is uniquely positioned to advance Physical AI through its world-class robotics expertise. I am honored to join the company at such a pivotal moment for the industry.
